about.source: Get the source code of this version
login.title: Sign in
login.expired: Your session has expired: please sign in again.
register.title: Create an account
register.warning: The password is stored nowhere: if you lose it, only the recovery key (shown after creation) can reopen the account.
recovery_key.title: Recovery key
recovery_key.intro: Write this key down and keep it safe. It is shown only once.
recovery_key.warning: Without your password or this key, your data is permanently inaccessible. Anyone holding the key has full access to the account.
recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Enter your username, your recovery key and a new password.
home.title: Home
home.no_mail_account: No mail account is configured yet. Mail account setup comes in the next step.
settings.title: Settings
settings.password.title: Change password
settings.password.done: Password changed. Other sessions were closed.
settings.recovery.title: Recovery key
settings.recovery.text: Generates a new key. The old one stops working.
settings.prefs.title: Preferences
error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error.password_short: The password must be at least %d characters long.
error.login_invalid: Invalid username: 3 to 64 characters, no spaces.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Try again in %d seconds.
error.csrf: Request refused (invalid security token). Reload the page.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
mailbox.placeholder: Select a message to read it.
accounts.title: Mail accounts
accounts.delete_confirm: Remove this mail account from wmail-go? Messages stay on the server.
accounts.first_intro: Welcome. Set up your first mail account: it must pass the connection test before it is saved.
accounts.form.title: Mail account
accounts.form.name: Account name (optional)
accounts.form.password_kept: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
accounts.form.smtp_same: Username and password left empty: the incoming ones are used.
accounts.form.block_remote: Block remote images and content in messages
accounts.form.trash_hint: Empty: automatic detection (IMAP \Trash attribute), otherwise "Trash". Created if missing.
accounts.test.fail.blocked: address refused by the server's network policy (private network not allowed)
accounts.test.fail.tls: encryption or certificate failure: check the chosen security and the port, or untick "Verify the server certificate" for a self-signed certificate
accounts.err.limit: Maximum number of mail accounts reached.
accounts.err.duplicate: This mailbox is already set up (same address and IMAP server).
accounts.err.first_must_pass: The first mail account must pass the connection test before it is saved.
mail.search.label: Search
mail.scope.subject: Subject
mail.sort_fallback: This folder is too large to be sorted this way on this server: messages are shown in arrival order.
mail.col.subject: Subject
mail.truncated: Part of the message exceeds the displayable size and was cut.
mail.partial: This message is damaged: only part of it could be read.
mail.remote_blocked: %d remote image(s) or content item(s) blocked to protect your privacy.
mail.no_body: This message has no displayable content.
mail.err.not_found: This message or folder no longer exists.
mail.err.too_large: This message is too large to be displayed.
mail.filter.label: Display filter
mail.no_unread: No unread message in this folder.
mail.pagesize.label: Messages per page
mail.sort.label: Sort
settings.layout.list: List only (the message opens on its own page)
settings.layout.bottom: 3 panes: folders, list on top and reading below
settings.panes.hint: Pane widths are set by dragging the dividers in the mailbox; they are saved with your account.
accounts.form.verify_hint: Untick to accept a self-signed, expired or wrongly named certificate: the connection stays encrypted, but the server's identity is not checked.
mail.clear.confirm: Permanently delete all %d messages in this folder? This cannot be undone.
mail.err.not_clearable: Only the trash and the junk folder can be emptied.
accounts.form.legacy: Allow legacy TLS protocols and ciphers
accounts.form.legacy_hint: For a server that only accepts TLS 1.0 or 1.1, or ciphers without forward secrecy (RSA key exchange, CBC). The connection stays encrypted but weaker: use it only for a server you cannot update.
accounts.test.fail.legacytls: this server only accepts legacy TLS protocols or ciphers: tick "Allow legacy TLS protocols and ciphers" for this server, or update it
compose.title: New message
compose.no_sent_note: No copy will be kept in a sent folder for this mailbox.
compose.subject: Subject
compose.opt.dsn: Request a delivery receipt from the server (DSN)
compose.err.uploading: Some attachments are still uploading: please wait a moment.
compose.err.attach_failed: An attachment could not be added
compose.err.too_large: The message exceeds the maximum size of %s MB.
compose.err.rejected: The server rejected these recipients: %s. The message was not sent.
compose.err.no_drafts: No drafts folder is used for this mailbox.
compose.err.attach_too_big: File too large (%d MB at most).
compose.err.attach_session: Too many pending attachments: send or discard a message first.
compose.sent_not_saved: Message sent, but its copy could not be saved to the sent folder.
compose.fwd.title: -------- Forwarded message --------
compose.fwd.subject: Subject
accounts.form.sent_hint: Empty: automatic detection (IMAP \Sent attribute), otherwise "Sent", created if missing. Enter - to keep no copy of sent messages.
accounts.form.signature_hint: Added below the text of new messages, preceded by "-- ". Variables: {{FROM}}, {{FROM-FULL}} (sender of the original message), {{DATE}}, {{TIME}}.
accounts.form.signature_before: Put the signature before the quoted message in replies
settings.prefs.reply_same_folder: Put the copy of a reply in the folder of the original message
activity.title: Account activity
activity.intro: Sign-ins and sensitive actions over the last %d days. This log is encrypted for you alone: neither the server administrator nor anyone else can read it.
activity.keep: This log cannot be cleared: that is what makes it worth keeping. An entry disappears on its own after %d days.
folders.system_hint: "Automatic" uses the folder designated by the server (IMAP attribute), otherwise a folder with the usual name, created if missing. Without a sent folder, no copy of sent messages is kept; without a drafts folder, the Save button disappears.
folders.name: Name
folders.empty_confirm: Permanently delete every message in “%s”? This cannot be undone.
folders.delete_confirm: Delete the folder "%s" AND all the messages it contains? This cannot be undone.
folders.delete_yes: Delete the folder and its messages
folders.err.name: Invalid folder name: it must not be empty or contain the folder separator, "*" or "%".
folders.err.protected: The inbox can be neither renamed nor deleted.
identities.title: Identities
identities.main: main identity, edited with the account
identities.name: Display name
identities.err.address: Invalid address in "Reply to" or "Automatic Bcc".
identities.err.duplicate: This address is already used by an identity of this mailbox.
compose.mode_confirm: Text formatting and images will be lost. Continue?
compose.tb.link_bad: Only http, https and mailto addresses are accepted.
accounts.form.sieve_enable: Enable filter management for this mailbox
accounts.form.sieve_hint: Empty: same server and credentials as IMAP, port 4190 with STARTTLS (port 2000 on some servers is an old convention).
filters.raw_active: A raw script is active: the filters in this list are not applied.
filters.name: Name
filters.raw_hint: Complete Sieve script: the server checks it before saving. When ticked, it replaces the filters in the list (which stay saved).
filters.raw_use: Use this script instead of the filters in the list
filters.no_condition: With no condition, the filter applies to every message.
filters.f.subject: Subject
filters.action: What to do with matching messages
filters.keep: Also keep a copy in the inbox
filters.vac_days: Delay between two replies to the same person (days)
filters.stop: Do not process the following filters
filters.overwrite: Replace this script with wmail-go filters
filters.err.name: Give the filter a name (100 characters at most).
filters.err.condition_type: This comparison does not suit this field (larger/smaller: size only).
filters.err.size: Invalid size: a number followed by K, M or G (for example 500K).
filters.err.module: The server does not support one of the requested features.
filters.err.server: The filter server refused the operation: %s
filters.err.foreign: The "rainloop.user" script on this server was not written by a filter client: it cannot be edited here without being replaced.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.close: Close the message or the window
settings.mailto_hint: Asks your browser to open email links in wmail-go (requires an HTTPS connection).
mail.mdn.ask: The sender asks to be notified when you read this message (receipt sent to %s).
mail.mdn.subject: Read receipt:
mail.mdn.body:
This is a read receipt for the message you sent.

Note: it only states that the message was displayed on the recipient's computer. There is no guarantee that the recipient read or understood its content.
quota.title: Space used on the server
settings.save_error: Could not save: use the “Save” button.
reorder.hint: Drag and drop rows to change the order.
reorder.error: The new order could not be saved.
folders.new_account_hint: The server's folder list appears once the mailbox is saved ("Automatic" suits most cases).
accounts.form.sieve_disable: Do not offer filters for this mailbox
filters.not_configured: Filters are disabled for this mailbox.
filters.err.unavailable: The filter server (ManageSieve) does not answer. Filters are managed by your mail server: if it does not offer them, or at another address, say so in the mailbox settings.
folders.toggle_pane: Hide or show the folder list
mail.act.read_all: Mark all messages in the folder as read
mail.act.unread_all: Mark all messages in the folder as unread
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.placeholder: Pick a contact, or create a new one.
contacts.import_hint: Contacts with an address already in the book are skipped.
contacts.err.empty: The contact is empty: enter at least a name or an address.
contacts.err.import: Unreadable file: choose a valid vCard or CSV file.
settings.prefs.contacts_autosave: Automatically add unknown recipients to contacts after sending
mail.adv.title: Advanced search
mail.adv.subject: Subject
settings.prefs.notify_desktop: Show a desktop notification for new messages
settings.prefs.notify_sound: Play a sound for new messages
compose.warn_subject: The message has no subject. Send it anyway?
compose.warn_attach: The text mentions an attachment, but no file is attached. Send it anyway?
compose.warn_many: This message has %d recipients. Send it anyway?
twofactor.title: Two-step authentication
twofactor.login_text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
twofactor.trust: Do not ask for the code for 2 weeks on this browser
twofactor.expired: The verification expired: sign in again.
twofactor.intro: Adds a one-time code (TOTP app: FreeOTP, Aegis, Google Authenticator…) at sign-in. The password alone is no longer enough.
twofactor.setup_text: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to confirm.
twofactor.secret: Key to type into your app (if you cannot scan the QR code):
twofactor.show_secret_text: Enter a valid code to show the secret and QR code again (setting up another device).
twofactor.codes_text: Keep these codes somewhere safe: each works once and they will not be shown again.
templates.intro: Ready-made texts you can insert into a message with one click (the “Template” button in the composer).
templates.name: Name
templates.err.invalid: Name and text are required (name: up to 100 characters, text: up to 20,000).
settings.background.label: Personal background image:
settings.background.hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB and 6,000 × 6,000 pixels. It replaces the theme background, for you only.
settings.background.invalid: Image rejected: choose a JPEG or PNG up to 2 MB and 6,000 × 6,000 pixels.
mail.dkim.pass: Valid DKIM signature for the sender's domain
mail.dkim.warn: DKIM signature missing, invalid or from another domain
contacts.sync.title: CardDAV synchronization
contacts.sync.intro: Keeps this address book identical to a CardDAV server's (Nextcloud, Radicale, Fastmail…). The most recent change wins; fields this book does not handle (photo…) are lost when a contact edited here is sent back.
contacts.sync.err.url: Invalid address: it must start with https://.
folders.check_hint: The inbox is always watched. You can pick %d other folders whose unread count is refreshed every 2 minutes.
mail.eml_drop: Drop the .eml file here to add it to this folder
mail.eml_error: The message could not be added (invalid or too large .eml file, or refused by the server).
mail.delete_forever_confirm: Permanently delete these messages? This cannot be undone.
mail.threads_unsupported: This server cannot group messages into conversations: the list shows one message per row.
keys.navigate: Move through the list (opens the message)
keys.panes: Switch between the list and the reading pane
settings.prefs.checkboxes: Show checkboxes in the message list
settings.prefs.favicon_count: Unread count on the tab icon
accounts.form.proxy_images: Load remote images through the server (the sender does not see your IP address)
mail.trust_sender: Always show images from this sender
settings.trusted.title: Trusted senders (images shown directly): %d
settings.prefs.timezone_hint: IANA name (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/Montreal). Empty: %s, the server setting.
folders.err.not_empty: This folder holds messages: move them or empty the folder before deleting it.
folders.err.has_children: This folder has subfolders: delete them first.
folders.err.system_delete: This folder has a system role (trash, sent, drafts, junk or archive): it cannot be deleted.
settings.prefs.avatars_hint: A picture stored in the address book is always used when present. With Gravatar, the server (never your browser) asks gravatar.com for the picture: the hash of your correspondents' addresses is sent to that service.
rich.toggle: Switch between plain text and formatting
templates.rich_hint: A formatted template is inserted as is into an HTML message, and converted to text in a plain-text message.
contacts.err.no_selection: Check one or more contacts first.
contacts.err.no_address: None of the checked contacts has an email address.
